an9.36:1.1: [sāvatthinidānaṃ] paṭhamampahaṃ bhikkhave jhānaṃ nissāya āsavānaṃ khayaṃ vadāmi.
an9.36:1.2: dutiyampahaṃ bhikkhave jhānaṃ nissāya āsavānaṃ khayaṃ vadāmi.
an9.36:1.3: tatiyampahaṃ bhikkhave jhānaṃ nissāya āsavānaṃ khayaṃ vadāmi.
an9.36:1.4: catutthampahaṃ bhikkhave jhānaṃ nissāya āsavānaṃ khayaṃ vadāmi.
an9.36:1.5: ākāsānañcāyatanampahaṃ bhikkhave nissāya āsavānaṃ khayaṃ vadāmi.
an9.36:1.6: viññānañcāyatanampahaṃ bhikkhave nissāya āsavānaṃ khayaṃ vadāmi.
an9.36:1.7: ākiñcāyatanampahaṃ bhikkhave nissāya āsavānaṃ khayaṃ vadāmi.
an9.36:1.8: nevasaññānāsaññāyatanampahaṃ bhikkhave nissāya āsavānaṃ khayaṃ vadāmi.
an9.36:1.9: saññāvedayitanirodhampahaṃ bhikkhave nissāya āsavānaṃ khayaṃ vadāmi.
an9.36:2.1: “paṭhamampahaṃ bhikkhave jhānaṃ nissāya āsavānaṃ khayaṃ vadāmī”ti iti kho panetaṃ vuttaṃ,
an9.36:2.3: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu vivicceva kāmehi …pe… paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati.
an9.36:2.4: so yadeva tattha hoti rūpagataṃ vedanāgataṃ saññāgataṃ saṅkhāragataṃ viññāṇagataṃ te dhamme aniccato dukkhato rogato gaṇḍato sallato aghato ābādhato parato palokato suññato anattato samanupassati.
an9.36:2.6: so tehi dhammehi cittaṃ paṭivāpetvā amatāya dhātuyā cittaṃ upasaṃharati.
an9.36:2.7: “etaṃ santaṃ etaṃ paṇītaṃ yadidaṃ sabbasaṅkhārasamatho sabbūpadhipaṭinissaggo taṇhakkhayo virāgo nirodho nibbāna”nti.
an9.36:2.8: so tattha ṭhito āsavānaṃ khayaṃ pāpuṇāti.
an9.36:2.9: no ce āsavānaṃ khayaṃ pāpuṇāti teneva dhammarāgena tāya dhammanandiyā pañcannaṃ orambhāgiyānaṃ saññojanānaṃ parikkhayā opapātiko hoti tattha parinibbāyi anāvattidhammo tasmā lokā.
an9.36:3.1: seyyathāpi bhikkhave issāso vā issāsantevāsī vā tiṇapurisake vā mattikāpuñje vā yoggaṃ karitvā so aparena samayena durepātī ca hoti akkhaṇavedhī ca mahato ca kāyassa padāletā.
an9.36:3.2: evameva kho bhikkhave bhikkhu vivicceva kāmehi …pe… paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati.
an9.36:3.3: so yadeva tattha hoti rūpagataṃ vedanāgataṃ saññāgataṃ saṅkhāragataṃ viññāṇagataṃ, te dhamme aniccato dukkhato rogato gaṇḍato sallato aghato ābādhato parato palokato suññato anattato samanupassati
an9.36:3.5: so tehi dhammehi cittaṃ paṭivāpetvā amatāya dhātuyā cittaṃ upasaṃharati.
an9.36:3.6: “etaṃ santaṃ etaṃ paṇītaṃ, yadidaṃ sabbasaṅkhārasamatho sabbūpadhipaṭinissaggo taṇhakkhayo virāgo nirodho nibbāna”nti.
an9.36:3.7: so tattha ṭhito āsavānaṃ khayaṃ pāpuṇāti.
an9.36:3.8: no ce āsavānaṃ khayaṃ pāpuṇāti. teneva dhammarāgena tāya dhammanandiyā pañcannaṃ orambhāgiyānaṃ saññojanānaṃ parikkhayā opapātiko hoti. tattha parinibbāyi anāvattidhammo tasmā lokā.
an9.36:3.9: “paṭhamampahaṃ bhikkhave jhānaṃ nissāyaṃ āsavānaṃ khayaṃ vadāmī”ti
an9.36:3.10: iti yaṃ taṃ vuttaṃ. idametaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ.
an9.36:6.1: ākāsānañcāyatanampahaṃ bhikkhave nissāya āsavānaṃ khayaṃ vadāmī”ti iti kho panetaṃ vuttaṃ,
an9.36:6.3: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu sabbaso rūpasaññānaṃ samatikkamā paṭighasaññānaṃ atthaṅgamā nānattasaññānaṃ amanasikārā ananto ākāso’ti ākāsānañcāyatanaṃ upasampajja viharati,
an9.36:6.4: so yadeva tattha hoti vedanāgataṃ saññāgataṃ saṅkhāragataṃ viññāṇagataṃ …pe…
an9.36:6.9: pañcannaṃ orambhāgiyānaṃ saññojanānaṃ parikkhayā opapātiko hoti tattha parinibbāyi anāvattidhammo tasmā lokā.
an9.36:7.1: seyyathāpi bhikkhave issāso vā issāsantevāsī vā tiṇapurisake vā mattikāpuñje vā yoggaṃ karitvā so aparena samayena durepātī ca hoti akkhaṇavedhī ca mahato kāyassa padāletā.
an9.36:7.2: evameva kho bhikkhave bhikkhu sabbaso rūpasaññānaṃ samatikkamā paṭighasaññānaṃ atthaṅgamā nānattasaññānaṃ amanasikārā ananto ākāsoti ākāsānañcāyatanaṃ upasampajja viharati.
an9.36:7.3: so yadeva tattha hoti rūpagataṃ vedanāgataṃ saññāgataṃ saṅkhāragataṃ viññāṇagataṃ …pe… so pañcannaṃ orambhāgiyānaṃ saññojanānaṃ parikkhayā opapātiko hoti tattha parinibbāyi
an9.36:7.5: ākāsānañcāyatanampahaṃ bhikkhave nissāya āsavānaṃ khayaṃ vadāmīti
an9.36:7.6: iti yaṃ taṃ vuttaṃ idametaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ.
an9.36:8.1: viññāṇañcāyatanampahaṃ bhikkhave nissāya āsavānaṃ khayaṃ vadāmīti …pe…
an9.36:8.2: ākiñcaññāyatanampahaṃ bhikkhave nissāya āsavānaṃ khayaṃ vadāmīti iti kho panetaṃ vuttaṃ,
an9.36:8.4: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu sabbaso viññāṇañcāyatanaṃ samatikkamma natthi kiñcīti ākiñcaññāyatanaṃ upasampajja viharati.
an9.36:8.5: so yadeva tattha hoti vedanāgataṃ saññāgataṃ …pe…
an9.36:9.8: parikkhayā opapātiko hoti tattha parinibbāyī anāvattidhammo tasmā lokā.
an9.36:9.9: ākiñcaññāyatanampahaṃ bhikkhave nissāya āsavānaṃ khayaṃ vadāmīti
an9.36:9.10: iti yaṃ taṃ vuttaṃ. idametaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ.
an9.36:10.1: iti kho bhikkhave yāvatā saññāsamāpatti tāvatā aññāpaṭivedho
an9.36:10.2: yāni ca kho imāni bhikkhave āyatanāni
an9.36:10.3: nevasaññānāsaññāyatanasamāpatti ca saññāvedayitanirodho ca jhāyīhete bhikkhave bhikkhūhi samāpattikusalehi samāpattivuṭṭhānakusalehi samāpajjitvā vuṭṭhahitvā samakkhātabbānīti vadāmīti.
